006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import java.util.stream.Stream;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.IDataTypeAdapter;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ICollectionValue;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItemVisitor;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function.IMapItem;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function.IMapKey;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IItemType;
018import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
019import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
020import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
021
022/**
023 * The interface shared by all atomic items, representing indivisible data
024 * values that serve as the fundamental building blocks for complex data
025 * structures in the Metaschema framework.
026 */
027public interface IAnyAtomicItem extends IAtomicValuedItem {
028  /**
029   * Get the type information for this item.
030   *
031   * @return the type information
032   */
033  @NonNull
034  static IAtomicOrUnionType<?> type() {
035    return IItemType.anyAtomic();
036  }
037
038  @Override
039  @NonNull
040  default IAnyAtomicItem toAtomicItem() {
041    return this;
042  }
043
044  /**
045   * Get the "wrapped" value represented by this item.
046   *
047   * @return the value
048   */
049  @Override
050  @NonNull
051  Object getValue();
052
053  /**
054   * Converts this atomic item to a string item representation.
055   *
056   * @return a new {@link IStringItem} containing the string representation of
057   *         this item
058   * @see #asString()
059   */
060  @NonNull
061  default IStringItem asStringItem() {
062    return IStringItem.valueOf(asString());
063  }
064
065  /**
066   * Get the item's string value.
067   *
068   * @return the string value value of the item
069   */
070  @NonNull
071  String asString();
072
073  @Override
074  default Stream<IAnyAtomicItem> atomize() {
075    return ObjectUtils.notNull(Stream.of(this));
076  }
077
078  /**
079   * Get the atomic item value as a map key for use with an {@link IMapItem}.
080   *
081   * @return the map key
082   */
083  @NonNull
084  IMapKey asMapKey();
085
086  /**
087   * Get the item's type adapter.
088   *
089   * @return the type adapter for the item
090   */
091  @NonNull
092  IDataTypeAdapter<?> getJavaTypeAdapter();
093
094  /**
095   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
096   * <p>
097   * This method simply returns the provided item, since it is already the same
098   * type.
099   *
100   * @param item
101   *          the item to cast
102   * @return the provided item
103   */
104  static IAnyAtomicItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
105    return item;
106  }
107
108  /**
109   * Cast the provided {@code item} to be the same type as this item.
110   *
111   * @param item
112   *          the item to cast
113   * @return an atomic item of this type
114   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
115   *           if the provided item type cannot be cast to this item type
116   */
117  @NonNull
118  IAnyAtomicItem castAsType(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item);
119
120  /**
121   * Determine if this and the other value are deeply equal, without relying on
122   * the dynamic context.
123   * <p>
124   * This is used by {@link IMapKey#isSameKey(IMapKey)} to determine key
125   * equivalence.
126   * <p>
127   * Item equality is defined by the
128   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-deep-equal">XPath 3.1
129   * fn:deep-equal</a> specification.
130   *
131   * @param other
132   *          the other value to compare to this value to
133   * @return the {@code true} if the two values are equal, or {@code false}
134   *         otherwise
135   */
136  boolean deepEquals(@Nullable ICollectionValue other);
137
138  @Override
139  default void accept(IItemVisitor visitor) {
140    visitor.visit(this);
141  }
142}
